description: Expert developer assistant for the FlexAIDdS entropy-driven molecular docking engine. Includes first-class support for automated generation of publication-quality Nature Reviews Drug Discovery-style cover figures (dramatic enthalpy/entropy balance visualizations with the Entropy–Enthalpy Index I_E–E, full FlexAID∆S branding, JetBrains Mono + thebonhomme.com typography, and scientifically accurate thermodynamic call-outs).

generate_flexaids_figure.description: Generate a scientifically robust, NRDD-style cover figure for FlexAID∆S thermodynamic analysis (enthalpy vs entropy, E-E index). Returns either the prompt (for deferred generation) or the path to a saved image + sidecar metadata JSON for reproducibility.

params.description: Figure parameters (all optional; sensible reference-cover defaults are used).

entropy_value.description: Representative TΔS (or |TΔS|) value in kcal/mol scale (e.g. 0.93).

tds_value.description: Value displayed as prominent -TΔS in the figure (e.g. 1.4).

enthalpy_value.description: Alias for tds_value (legacy manifest key; maps to -TΔS display slot).

style.description: Visual style matching the reference NRDD covers: 'dramatic_faces' (personified blue entropy vs fiery enthalpy faces) or 'molecular_gauge' (abstract protein structures + central E-E gauge).

subtitle.description: Subtitle (e.g. 'Striking the right pose in drug discovery').

image_generator.description: Optional injectable image generator callable. Must accept a single prompt string and return a dict with at least {'path': <str>}. If omitted, the function returns the prompt for the caller (skill runtime) to generate using its native tool (Grok image_gen, DALL·E, etc.).

output_dir.description: Directory in which to write the generated image and sidecar metadata JSON (created if necessary).

prompt_overrides.description: Optional safe overrides for a few prompt fields (title, subtitle, date, volume). Unknown keys are rejected.

prompt.description: The fully constructed, ready-to-use image prompt (always present).

path.description: Absolute path to the saved image file (present only when an image_generator was supplied and succeeded).

metadata_path.description: Absolute path to the sidecar JSON (params + prompt + generation details) for full reproducibility (present when a file was written).

metadata.description: Reproducibility metadata from the canonical prompt builder (always present).

notes: This action is bulletproof: strict validation, no hard dependency on any image-generation library (injected callable), safe prompt overrides, deterministic unique filenames, and a complete metadata sidecar. It reuses the canonical prompt builder from python/flexaidds/figures for consistency with the rest of the FlexAIDdS tooling and branding (JetBrains Mono + thebonhomme.com typography, PLIP-style interaction clarity on most favourable/CF contacts, scientific guardrails, etc.). The /flexaidds skill (SKILL.md) documents how agents should invoke it and supply their platform's native image tool via the image_generator parameter.
